Technologies are one of the methods used for spreading knowledge all over the world. Now a days, cellphones are one of among that are widely used in the schools for educational

purposes. Cellphones are convenient to get knowledge; however, it is also one of the technologies that cause destruction and healthy problems.

Cellphones are becoming the most destructive in the classrooms. As cellphones are designed for various purposes, it can easily misguide students' goal and make less productive to their task. For instance, If a student have a goal to finish studying for the test by using the study guide pdf on his phone, this student is less likely to be successful on his study because of different destructions like: poping texts, messages, social medias, games, and so.

Some peoples may say cellphones are helpful for searching further educational knowledges, are convenient for learning procedures, or serving as references. That's true, it may have several advantages. However, it will effect on your healthies. For example, a student may study the entire block on his cellphone for his SOL exam. This student will cause for different healthy issues due to it's radation such as: weakness of sight/retina, eye cancer, and so on.

To sum up, Using cellphones in the classroom effects in students' education. In order to pay attention and focus in the class, using different materials for educational purposes is more effective for students rather than using cellphones in the classrooms.
